lines.text: Vulnerable persons such as the elderly, pregnant women and individuals with chronic heart or lung disease may wear an N95 mask to reduce exposure when the air quality forecast is in the Very Unhealthy range (PSI >200) and if they have to be outdoors for several hours.
lines.condition: Ministry of Health Singapore haze health advisory

lines.text: However, the elderly, pregnant women and those with severe lung or heart problems who have difficulty breathing at rest or on exertion should consult their doctor before using an N95 mask.
lines.condition: Ministry of Health Singapore haze health advisory

lines.text: Any person who feels discomfort when using an N95 mask should take a break from using the mask.
